meta.problem: A financial-analysis tool for individual European listed stocks. The front-end already exists (4-slice React model that loads a schema-v2 JSON). The missing piece is /collect: an agent that turns a ticker into a provenance-stamped schema-v2 dataset the model can render. First name: ASML.

agent.name: constellation-collect
agent.model_rationale: Newest Opus-class — deep, multi-step financial reasoning (line-item mapping to a fixed schema, balance-check enforcement, CAPM WACC construction, provenance). Quality first; an on-demand run costs cents.
agent.system_summary: Given a European listed ticker, web-fetches the last 5 fiscal years, maps every figure to Constellation's schema-v2 contract (balance checks to zero), constructs the W1 Market WACC (CAPM point + band) to replace the placeholder, sets arena valuation-multiple bands, and emits <TICKER>_schema-v2.json + <TICKER>_valuation.xlsx + sources.json to /mnt/session/outputs/. Follows the constellation-valuation house-method skill on every run.
never_dos: Never emit a schema-v2 JSON that fails validation or whose balance check does not reach zero
Never blend the three WACC objects (W1 market / W2 imputed / W3 regulated); for a listed name compute only W1
Never state a number without a source URL and a date
Never present WACC as a single figure — always a point plus a band
Never claim the workbook recomputes from formulas — it is a snapshot (values + provenance + integrity block)
Analysis and drafting only: never place trades, contact anyone, or take any external action

outcome.description: Produce a Constellation schema-v2 valuation dataset for the given European listed ticker: provenance-stamped statements that balance to zero, a constructed W1 WACC band, and arena multiple bands — as <TICKER>_schema-v2.json + <TICKER>_valuation.xlsx + sources.json, loadable unchanged into the 4-slice front-end.
rubric_criteria: Valid schema-v2: output JSON has the exact keys (years; income{revenue,costOfSales,depreciation,sga,interestIncome,interestExpense,incomeTaxes}; balance{operatingCash,otherCurrentAssets,ppe,otherOperatingAssets,accountsPayable,otherNonInterestLiab,longTermDebt,equity}; assumptions{taxRate,wacc}; sharesOutstanding; valuationMultiples; labels), and the balance sheet checks to zero every year within rounding
Three-WACC discipline: only W1 (Market WACC) is computed; CAPM parameters (rf, ERP, beta, cost of debt, tax, weights) are each a stated field with source URL + date
WACC is a band, not a number: reported as point + band (rf and ERP at edges); the point is written to assumptions.wacc; the ROIC−WACC spread is judged against the band
Provenance on every input: each schema-v2 figure carries a source URL + as-of date in sources.json; load-bearing numbers show a cross-check

Locked conventions reproduced: NOPLAT = EBIT×(1−tax); ROIC on prior-year invested capital; capex-incl = ΔnetPPE + D&A; net debt = interest-bearing debt − operating cash; invested-capital assets side = financing side — the workbook's computed panels match these

Deliverables complete + honesty block: schema-v2 JSON + snapshot .xlsx (values + provenance + integrity block) + sources.json, with the CAPM-on-single-name-beta / claims-are-relative / web-weaker-than-filings caveats stated; no formula-recompute claim

connections.notes: v0 uses public web only (networking on). Next direction: a fundamentals data API / filings source + vault credential for stronger S0 provenance and cleaner extraction.

skills.name: constellation-valuation
skills.purpose: House method: schema-v2 contract + locked accounting conventions + W1 CAPM/band construction + provenance rule + honesty block + deliverable spec

schedule.human: On-demand, per ticker. Scheduled watchlist refresh is a Next direction.
schedule.kickoff: user.define_outcome (task + rubric above), triggered per ticker

front_end.what: Constellation 4-slice React model (statements · performance · health · valuation football-field), loads schema-v2 JSON via paste/upload
front_end.v0_autoload: Local pipeline injects the agent's schema-v2 JSON into a single-file render of the 4 slices (constellation-model.template.html → outputs/<TICKER>_model.html), which opens straight to the model — no manual paste.
front_end.schema_v2_keys: schemaVersion, company, unit, years[], income{7}, balance{8}, assumptions{taxRate,wacc}, sharesOutstanding[], valuationMultiples{industry,evRevenue,evEbitda,evEbit,pe,growth}, labels{}

cases.name: case-01
cases.expected: evals/case-01/expected.json (founder's hand-verified ASML SAMPLE from the slices)

evals.notes: Case 1 golden = the ASML SAMPLE embedded in the front-end slices. Statement inputs + sharesOutstanding + taxRate are the extraction targets (must match within tolerance). assumptions.wacc (0.1) and valuationMultiples (tech-saas) are PLACEHOLDERS the agent must improve — graded on defensibility + provenance, not equality. Held-back regression set = further European names (AIR.PA, SAP, …) added as their expecteds land. Re-run before promoting any new agent version.

defaults_applied.write_actions: None in v0 — analysis and drafting only

interface.who: Stéphane (own research); later customer-facing via the front-end
interface.how: Agent emits schema-v2 JSON + xlsx + sources to /mnt/session/outputs/; local pipeline downloads to ./my-agent/outputs/ and injects the JSON into the 4-slice viewer (auto-load, no paste). Console for run history.
